title: Sociotechnic recipient Markdown output contract v1
description: Explicit opt-in body contract. Write only the Markdown record shown by the applicable example, not a JSON wrapper. The dispatch chooses the record kind and pinned stage IDs. src/recipient-contract.ts#validateRecipientOutput enforces body rules; JSON Schema alone does not validate Markdown structure. Existing src/verdict.ts#parseRecord remains authoritative for markers, commits, provider errors and verdict consistency. This contract never changes scope, touches, commit binding or gate policy.
x-commonRules: Each required ## heading must occur exactly once with nonempty content outside fenced code.
Required headings are case-insensitive and use exactly the documented heading text.
Extra sections do not replace required sections. Fenced headings do not count.
Marker lines and COMMIT lines follow the existing engine record contract. COMMIT must name the real committed HEAD. Example SHAs are illustrative only.

research.description: Answer the bounded question directly and give repository evidence with file paths and line numbers. BLOCKED research retains Answer and Evidence; no separate Blocker heading is required by the research brief.
examples:
STATUS: DONE

## Answer

The handler validates the input before saving.

## Evidence

- src/handler.ts:12 validates the input.

build.description: Acceptance has - [x] or - [ ] bullets describing actual verification, one per plan acceptance criterion. Deviations has bullets explaining departures, or - none. BLOCKED adds a nonempty Blocker explaining the human decision needed. This structural validator cannot establish whether acceptance evidence is true or complete.
examples:
STATUS: READY
COMMIT: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

## Summary

Implemented the approved input validation.

## Acceptance

- [x] Invalid input is rejected; verified by the handler unit test.

## Deviations

- none

## Notes for reviewers

The focused handler tests passed at the recorded commit.
STATUS: BLOCKED
COMMIT: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

## Summary

Implementation awaits a human scope decision.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Validation is incomplete; the required schema choice is unresolved.

## Deviations

- none

## Notes for reviewers

No passing verification is claimed.

## Blocker

Choose which of the incompatible input schemas must be supported.

x-findingRules: Each nonblank Findings line is one bullet: - [severity] <path[:line] or general> — <text>.
Severity is critical, high, medium or low, case-insensitive. Unknown severities and malformed bullets are rejected.
Location and finding text must be nonempty. The existing parser also accepts * bullets and separators – or -- or spaced -.
With no findings, write the single line None. Do not mix None. with other content.
PASS with blocking findings and agent-authored SKIPPED remain governed by the existing parser.
examples:
VERDICT: PASS
COMMIT: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

## Findings

None.

## Notes

The changed handler follows the existing validation pattern.
VERDICT: CHANGES
COMMIT: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

## Findings

- [high] src/handler.ts:12 — Empty input bypasses validation.

## Notes

Add coverage for empty input before approval.

conformance.description: Apply the review Findings rules. Plan steps is a Markdown table with exactly stage | status | justification columns and a separator row. Every pinned stage ID must occur exactly once; use its exact ID, not a title or a position. Status is implemented, partial or missing for pinned stages. Additional rows must use a unique added:<path> ID and status added. Reject duplicate, missing and unrelated IDs and unknown statuses. Partial, missing and added rows require a nonempty justification. Added rows do not grant scope permission: existing touches, deviations, semantic review and gate policy still apply.
examples:
VERDICT: PASS
COMMIT: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

## Findings

None.

## Notes

The implementation and build evidence cover the pinned stages.

## Plan steps

| stage | status | justification |
| --- | --- | --- |
| s1 | implemented | Handler validation and its acceptance test are present. |
| s2 | implemented | The documented request shape matches the handler. |

decision.description: Reasons contains nonempty bullets. ESCALATE adds a nonempty Escalation naming the hard rule (a), (b), (c) or (d) that fired: missing acceptance evidence, unexplained plan deviation, build/conformance disagreement, or an unverifiable record claim. The structural validator does not decide whether approval or escalation is warranted.
examples:
DECISION: APPROVE
COMMIT: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

## Reasons

- The recorded acceptance evidence and passing reviews support approval.
DECISION: ESCALATE
COMMIT: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

## Reasons

- The build does not provide evidence for the invalid-input criterion.

## Escalation

Rule (a): acceptance evidence is missing.
